intro: Built for modern living, our Marc wardrobe offers durable steel strength, smart storage, and sleek style—designed to fit your space and simplify your day.

features.title: Built to last a lifetime
features.text: Made with premium CRCA steel and advanced powder coating, the wardrobe is rust-resistant, termite-proof, and ready to stand the test of time.

features.title: Spacious, versatile storage
features.text: Includes full-length hanging space, adjustable shelves, and drawers—everything you need to store clothes, accessories, or documents with ease.

features.title: Safe and secure locker
features.text: An integrated locker gives you a private space to store valuables, ensuring safety and peace of mind right inside your wardrobe.

features.title: Privacy redefined
features.text: Your belongings deserve the safest home. Secure your most valued items with ease, thanks to a reliable door lock, ensuring peace of mind whenever you need it.

care: Wipe your steel almirah design for bedroom with a soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery of your stylish wardrobe. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping it next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
